question: Why does the Lord declare the universe to be nothing other than himself?
premises: The Lord has spoken that the universe is not otherwise than himself
The freedom of undivided consciousness shines forth on the path of difference
What appears as difference is the expression of that same freedom
inference: The universe is identical with the Lord because undivided consciousness freely appears as difference.
plain_english: The Lord has indeed declared that the universe is not other than that, because the freedom of undivided consciousness shines forth on the path of difference.
